input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full. § 24.1 gives us an unconditional affiliate/successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, sale of substantially all assets) assignment right without Vendor consent, subject only to prompt notice; § 13.3 carries the same carve-out through to licence rights. § 24.2 binds Vendor to our prior written consent (reasonableness qualified) for assignment, delegation of material performance or transfer by change of control, and bars assignment to a direct competitor. § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on our change of control, and requires cooperation with successor administrative changes. § 24.3 is only a residual gate for "other assignments" outside the 24.1 carve-out, is mutual, and is qualified by a not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed standard, so it does not cut back our M&A rights. No conflicting change-of-control trigger exists elsewhere (§ 9.2 insolvency termination expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance). No redline needed.
